WITH joined AS (
  SELECT s.gbsize, s.spanmin, si.healtheval
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0
        THEN gbsize / spanmin ELSE NULL END) as group_avg,
    COUNT(*) as group_count
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM group_stats
  WHERE group_avg IS NOT NULL
),
paired AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.group_avg,
    gs.group_count,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE gs.group_avg IS NOT NULL 
    AND oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND gs.group_avg > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT
  AVG(group_avg) as avg_status_group_avg,
  AVG(group_count) as avg_group_record_count,
  AVG(group_avg - overall_avg) as avg_difference
FROM paired
